text:
owen: FYI — build scanner flagged CVE-2026-2987 in libyaml pulled into our inference-worker base image via transitive dep yaml-sys. EPSS 0.72, CVSS 7.5. Found in prod image tag inference-worker:2026-03-19. Pinging triage.
sre-bot: scanbot: trivy v0.42.0 report attached. libyaml 0.2.3 -> fixed in 0.2.6. Advisory: https://osv.dev/notes/CVE-2026-2987
jia: can you paste the dep chain and which images are impacted? @owen
owen: command I used: `./scripts/find-deps.sh --image inference-worker:2026-03-19 | grep libyaml`
owen: sample output:
```
/opt/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/yaml/_yaml.cpython-311-x86_64-linux-gnu.so -> libyaml.so.2.0.3
/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libyaml.so.2.0.3 (installed via yaml-sys -> binding crate)
```
maria: quick question on exploitability — EPSS moderate but any public PoC? I don't see one in OSV or GitHub issues right now.
sre-bot: intel-bot: no confirmed public PoC detected in OSV/GitHub/Twitter. No active exploitation signals in our telemetry. EPSS suggests increased likelihood but not confirmed PoC.
alexk: recommendation: bump libyaml to 0.2.6 in base-image, rebuild all inference-worker variants, run canary (5% traffic). Also consider backport to 1.14.x LTS image tags. Also add image signing post-build (KMS) to ensure provenance.
markg: if we can't get patch out immediately, mitigation options: 1) disable YAML parsing of untrusted payloads in worker (use safe_load + schema validation), 2) add runtime gating for config loads, 3) add audit logs for YAML parse failures.
security-oncall: assigning owners: @jia to open bump PR + run tests, @owen to run canary deploy and capture perf/crash logs, @maria to monitor external exploit chatter. Target: patch + canary within 6h, full rollout in 24h if green.
jia: ack. I'll start PR to bump package and update Dockerfile. Will include CI matrix and link to regression tests.
owen: I'll prepare canary steps. Build command I'll use: `gcloud builds submit --tag gcr.io/redwood/inference-worker:2026-03-19-patch1` then deploy rollout to 5% via `kubectl set image --record`. Will capture latency and error logs.
maria: :thumbsup: add a post-deploy smoke that exercises the YAML parsing paths (config reload + model spec ingestion).
alexk: propose rule for intake matrix: if EPSS > 0.5 and CVSS >= 7.0 => P1 (patch within 24h, canary ASAP). We'll update triage doc after this incident.
security-oncall: I'll add this to the intake board and create a short runbook with rollback image tags and owner checklist.
owen: note on KMS/RBAC: ensure image manifest signing uses our CI KMS key. If we need deploy-permission changes to sign or rotate keys, ping @infra-ops.
infra-ops: we have CI roles for KMS signing already. No RBAC changes required for immediate signing. We can rotate keys if security requests it; allow ~2h for rotation and new key bootstrap.
security-oncall: update: PR #468 created by jia, CI passing. Can deploy canary at 12:45 UTC. Will monitor and update thread.
owen: deployed canary -> initial telemetry: 0.02% error delta, no crashes, latency within baseline. Posting logs to /internal/sec/patches/468.
maria: monitoring external feeds and telemetry — no chatter so far. Keeping watch for 12h.
security-oncall: closing loop for now — action items: jia complete backports, owen full rollout if canary stays green, infra-ops confirm signing in CI, alexk to update prioritization matrix. If anything changes, reopen thread. Thanks all.
